title: Public FQDN Semantic Contract
purpose: Define the gateway-neutral public HTTP and HTTPS edge semantics required before v2-proof tag authorisation can be considered. This contract defines future staging and production FQDN requirements without proving delivery and without making the Test environment depend on public internet.

requiredHostnames.purpose: Future staging public edge root FQDN proof boundary.
requiredHostnames.claimBoundary: Defines the future staging public FQDN contract only. It does not claim staging readiness.

environments.additionalHostnamePolicy: Additional hostnames such as www, app, api, auth, telemetry, or health are not required until explicitly declared with environment, purpose, protocol, proof command, owner, risk owner, and control owner.

requiredHostnames.purpose: Future production public edge root FQDN proof boundary.
requiredHostnames.claimBoundary: Defines the future production public FQDN contract only. It does not claim production readiness.

environments.additionalHostnamePolicy: Additional hostnames such as www, app, api, auth, telemetry, or health are not required until explicitly declared with environment, purpose, protocol, proof command, owner, risk owner, and control owner.

dnsResolutionSemantics.proofBoundary: DNS proof is required later by USF-263; this contract defines the expected semantics only.

tlsHttpsSemantics.proofBoundary: TLS and HTTPS proof is required later by USF-263; this contract defines the expected semantics only.

publicHttpEdgeCapability.semanticRequirement: Public HTTP and HTTPS edge capability for declared FQDNs. No gateway product is semantically required.

cloudflareBoundary.supplierBoundary: Cloudflare is the declared DNS and edge hosting provider boundary according to the human operator. This is provider-boundary evidence organization, not live-provider readiness.

publicTelemetryBootstrap.proofBoundary: USF-264 must prove only public route delivery and telemetry bootstrap. It must not prove product UI readiness or browser E2E readiness.

testEnvironmentBoundary.rationale: The Test environment remains local, composed, and synthetic. Public FQDN semantics are post-Test and pre-Staging proof gates.

remainingProofBoundaries.boundary: External DNS TLS HTTPS and proof endpoint delivery are not proven by this semantic contract.
Playwright public-route delivery and Faro or Sentry telemetry bootstrap are not proven by this semantic contract.
v2-proof tag authorisation is blocked until USF-262, USF-263, and USF-264 are Done or explicitly bounded with approved rationale.
